firstMilestone: Proposed: owner sign-in → edit one project → private preview → explicit publish → verify live

providerEvidence.state: Authenticated Supabase new-project page blocked at the two-active-free-project limit. Owner direction remains unanswered; no service was changed.

stories.title: Verified static delivery
stories.goal: Keep a working public site and required merge checks.
acceptance: Static build and verification are repeatable.
Required PR checks protect master; recovery rehearsal and limits are documented.

stories.title: Portfolio content and case studies
stories.goal: Present current professional work and personal projects clearly.
acceptance: Four project overviews link to full case studies.
Product Watch leads; retired puzzle-project references are absent.

stories.title: Interactive Engineering Lab
stories.goal: Let visitors explore requests, API compatibility, access and search.
acceptance: Lab starts collapsed and opens manually.
Demo help uses information icons, functional descriptions and keyboard/tap access.

stories.title: Readable mobile site and themes
stories.goal: Support useful reading and navigation on small screens.
acceptance: Navy and Teal, mobile navigation, focus and contrast received bounded checks.
Mobile case-study, return, CV-download and contact journeys were reviewed; this is not full WCAG certification.

stories.title: Public CV
stories.goal: Provide a polished CV consistent with the portfolio.
acceptance: Two-page PDF layout was rendered and visually reviewed.
Public download matches the reviewed PDF; wording release merged in PR 62.

stories.title: Discovery and asset delivery
stories.goal: Provide canonical pages, sharing metadata and compact images.
acceptance: Canonical metadata, sitemap, icons and case sharing images are present.
Responsive image variants and the static asset checks pass.

stories.title: Reconciled roadmap and story outlook
stories.goal: See current work without relying on the 2025 migration plan.
acceptance: Historical roadmap is preserved and current milestones replace its dates.
Story IDs, acceptance criteria, dependencies and a repeatable outlook are available.

stories.title: Choose a feasible backend direction
stories.goal: Resolve dedicated CMS capacity without disrupting separate projects.
acceptance: Owner chooses free-backend comparison, available Supabase capacity or paid-option assessment.
Fresh account/provider evidence and any cost approval are recorded before provisioning.

stories.title: Confirm the first release boundary
stories.goal: Agree what the first dynamic milestone delivers.
acceptance: Review the proposed project-only sign-in, draft, preview and publish workflow.
Record which existing content remains repository-owned, and place blog, contact form and media management in explicit later milestones.

stories.title: Accept hosting, API and session design
stories.goal: Use one coherent runtime and owner-authentication boundary.
acceptance: Review host/runtime, EU processing, quotas, auth/session transport and private/public cache rules.
Record owner acceptance of the concrete decision revision, rollback and tests; choosing Angular alone is insufficient.

stories.title: Draft version and independence plan
stories.goal: Prepare a reproducible Angular foundation without company dependencies.
acceptance: Revalidate exact public Angular, Node, npm, TypeScript, RxJS and tooling versions together.
Document clean task-local registry/auth/cache isolation and lifecycle-script review; this story does not authorise installation.

stories.title: Accept content and release contracts
stories.goal: Make draft, publication and operating rules implementable.
acceptance: Accept project schema, revision/concurrency model, allowed content, asset references and publication jobs.
Accept CSP/media strategy, provider limits, backup/restore goals, browser baseline and dependency allowlist; retain the closed gate until acceptance is evidenced.

stories.title: Create the isolated Angular workspace
stories.goal: Build an original Angular application alongside the working static product.
acceptance: Fresh public CLI workspace uses accepted exact versions and isolated npm configuration.
Static build remains usable; preserve dormant Next files until their migration/removal is separately authorised.

stories.title: Enforce build and architecture checks
stories.goal: Catch boundary and dependency violations before merge.
acceptance: Clean checkout install, lint, formatting, type checks, tests and production build pass.
CI rejects forbidden registry/import/token/content-execution examples and requires no production secrets; planned checks are labelled until proven active.

stories.title: Port the approved public experience
stories.goal: Keep the current visual identity and useful content when Angular replaces the public renderer.
acceptance: Port the reviewed homepage, Lab, experience, case studies and CV links through typed fixtures.
Preserve Navy/Teal preference, keyboard behaviour and reading without JavaScript; compare 320/390/768/1024/1280px layouts.

stories.title: Preserve public URLs and discovery
stories.goal: Keep shared links and search identities valid.
acceptance: Prerender declared public routes; unknown or unpublished entries return genuine 404 responses.
Preserve legacy HTML URLs/fragments and approved redirects; metadata and sitemap agree with rendered content.

stories.title: Implement content storage and policies
stories.goal: Store drafts and immutable approved revisions safely.
acceptance: Versioned migrations enforce constraints and authorised operations with isolated test data.
Direct database/data-API tests deny drafts and mutations to anonymous, non-owner and owner-before-MFA actors; immutable history cannot be edited.

stories.title: Implement owner sign-in and MFA
stories.goal: Allow only the owner to manage content.
acceptance: Password plus authenticator MFA, no public signup, logout and expiry work.
Every private operation verifies identity/MFA; invalid, revoked and pre-MFA sessions fail and private responses are no-store.

stories.title: Rehearse owner recovery
stories.goal: Recover access without bypassing MFA.
acceptance: Document and test lost-authenticator/session-revocation recovery in an isolated account/environment.
Recovery restores MFA before granting content access; no credentials are committed.

stories.title: Edit project metadata and summaries
stories.goal: Update project information without editing repository HTML.
acceptance: Edit approved project fields, technology labels, status, display order and public-safe links.
Validate all input server-side; private repository links and unknown fields cannot enter public actions.

stories.title: Save drafts and handle conflicts
stories.goal: Keep edits safe without silently changing the live site.
acceptance: Saving, saved, failed, unsaved and conflict states are visible; failed saves retain the in-memory buffer.
Expected-version checks reject stale writes from another tab; saving alone does not publish.

stories.title: Preview the exact draft privately
stories.goal: Review a draft as it will appear publicly.
acceptance: Owner/MFA-only preview uses the public renderer and the exact draft version.
Draft URLs, media and payloads remain private/no-store and absent from search, feeds and public builds.

stories.title: Publish an immutable release
stories.goal: Publish exactly the reviewed content through a reliable build job.
acceptance: Explicit owner/MFA publish commits an immutable revision, asset references, release manifest and durable job atomically.
Trusted builds use the approved code/content snapshot; serial promotion, retries and failures work without an open browser or in-memory queue.

stories.title: Verify live state and withdrawal
stories.goal: Know which revision is actually public.
acceptance: Mark live only after deployed release identity, pages, assets and metadata are verified; failed or superseded jobs cannot overwrite newer releases.
Test unpublish, redirects, historical deployment exposure and withdrawal during outages; measure the proposed healthy five-minute target.

stories.title: Export and restore content
stories.goal: Recover both content and assets when a provider fails.
acceptance: Versioned exports include drafts, revisions, assets and references in private encrypted storage.
Clean-environment restore and provider pause/outage exercises meet the accepted recovery/retention goals; static fallback is rehearsed.

stories.title: Validate the first dynamic release
stories.goal: Prove the first editing workflow works safely end to end.
acceptance: Production-build public/editor/error journeys and direct policy tests pass, including draft exclusion, concurrent saves, XSS/URL rejection and rollback.
Review both palettes, keyboard/contrast, supported browsers, headers, bundle/performance budgets and regional/quota evidence; field metrics require sufficient traffic.

stories.title: Approve and perform production cutover
stories.goal: Move the public domain only after the owner accepts release evidence.
acceptance: Owner explicitly authorises production/domain cutover and any affected provider settings.
Verify canonical URLs, redirects, release identity and monitoring after cutover; preserve the tested static rollback.

stories.title: Author blog posts with safe structured content
stories.goal: Write technical articles without executable CMS markup.
acceptance: Accepted versioned document format supports approved text, headings, lists, code, quotes and links with bounded validation.
Unknown nodes, hostile URLs and unsupported schemas fail safely; no CMS HTML/MDX/JavaScript execution.

stories.title: Publish and browse the blog
stories.goal: Read only verified published articles.
acceptance: Listing, article routes, tags, pagination, code rendering and accessible reading work with prerendered HTML.
Drafts remain excluded; sitemap, RSS, canonical/social metadata and redirects use the same deployed release.

stories.title: Upload and manage private media
stories.goal: Add images with controlled processing and publication references.
acceptance: Validate decoded type, size and dimensions; re-encode and strip metadata within accepted runtime bounds.
Draft delivery is owner-only; published delivery requires a live reference, alt/decorative intent and accepted cache/withdrawal rules.

stories.title: Accept contact messages safely
stories.goal: Let visitors contact the owner with clear submission feedback.
acceptance: Accessible validation, fixed recipient/verified sender, server validation and origin/CSRF rules match the accepted API design; keep mailto fallback.
Atomic shared quotas and duplicate-safe provider requests handle concurrent submissions, uncertain outcomes and outages; previews cannot send real mail.

stories.title: Maintain the dynamic service
stories.goal: Keep dependencies, quotas and recovery evidence current.
acceptance: Define maintenance ownership and review cadence for patches, provider terms, quotas and logs without unnecessary visitor tracking.
Repeat restore and access reviews after relevant changes; record actionable failures and owners in the outlook.

stories.title: Optional AI writing suggestions
stories.goal: Consider bounded draft assistance after core editing is reliable.
acceptance: Separate owner acceptance covers provider, terms, quota and activation.
Suggestions require human review, affect drafts only and have timeout/kill-switch behaviour; exhausted quotas never block editing.

stories.title: Unaccepted expansion ideas
stories.goal: Keep the old wish list out of committed delivery scope.
acceptance: Newsletter, comments, visitor accounts, payments, chatbot, analytics, dark mode and live GitHub integration remain deferred/unaccepted.
Any re-entry needs an explicit owner request and affected design acceptance; the old roadmap is not authority.
